# Plot category response curves

Draws the probability of each response category against ability, as in
the single-trait tabs of the Models menu: one coloured line per category
with a marker at every ability, a gray line at a probability of 0.5, and
a legend in which a click hides or shows a curve.

## Usage

``` r
plot_category_curves(
  theta,
  probs,
  title = "",
  subtitle = NULL,
  ylab = "P(X=m|theta)"
)
```

## Arguments

- theta:

  Numeric vector of abilities.

- probs:

  Matrix of probabilities, one row for each value of `theta` and one
  column for each category, as returned by
  [`prob_gpcm()`](https://sedzinfo.github.io/golemirt/reference/prob_gpcm.md)
  and the other `prob_*()` functions; the column names label the
  categories.

- title:

  Title of the plot.

- subtitle:

  Optional note, shown on a second, smaller line of the title.

- ylab:

  Title of the vertical axis.

## Value

A `plotly` object.

## Examples

``` r
theta <- seq(-6, 6, by = 0.1)
plot_category_curves(theta, prob_grm(theta), "Graded Response Model")
```
